entries.b-02-quiet: {"segments": [{"kind": "changed", "text": "There are no items to report in this briefing. Nothing has changed for Priya since the last briefing, so no labelled items (C1) appear below. No one is waiting on her, so there are no W items. She has no open promises, so there are no P items. No questions are left open, so there are no Q items.", "ref": null}, {"kind": "changed", "text": "Because every category is empty, there is nothing to list, and I have not invented any entries. Priya can use this time for planned work or to get ahead on anything she chooses herself. If she expects something to be here, such as a reply from a colleague or a change to a project, it may be worth checking directly, since it has not reached me.", "ref": null}]}
entries.b-03-never-record: {"segments": [{"kind": "changed", "text": "- C1: Move to a weekly on-call rotation from December (decided in Ops planning). This is settled, so stop debating it and plan around it. Check that the December start date gives people enough notice, and tell anyone who will be affected before the schedule goes out.", "ref": null}, {"kind": "changed", "text": "- P1: Draft the on-call handbook (due next Tuesday, from Ops planning). This is your only open promise and it has a firm date. Block time for it early in the week. Build it around the weekly rotation from C1: who is on call, how handovers work, and who to escalate to. Keep the first draft short and send it out for comments rather than polishing it alone.", "ref": null}, {"kind": "changed", "text": "Nobody is waiting on you right now, and no questions are open. That leaves the handbook as the one thing to deliver. Get it done on time, because the December rotation depends on people having clear instructions before it begins.", "ref": null}]}
